script.thesis: Repair is the sentence you say after the fight, not the fight you win.
script.monologue: Don't finish the argument first. Being right is a cheap exit. Put the folded letter down. Stay after the heat. Silence after heat is still a choice. Walk back to the same chair. Ask before you leave the room. Open the letter. Stay anyway. Repair starts when someone returns.
